title: Hybrid Approaches to Detect Comments Violating Macro Norms on Reddit
reasoning: The paper describes a technical process for identifying and classifying violations of community 'macro norms' (such as hate speech or personal attacks) on Reddit for the purpose of online moderation. While these norms represent social and behavioral standards, the study is focused on data science and classification methodologies rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or traditions.
